notes.title: My Cozy Hidden Object Game is Live – Try the Demo! 🔍🧙‍♀️🐱🐾
notes.notes:
[h2]Hidden Magical Creatures demo is finally live![/h2]
The game is about a cute little witch named Violet and her talking cat, Theo. One day, while making a spell, Theo accidentally knocked the wrong bottle into the cauldron.
This accident opened a portal, allowing many creatures from different dimensions to enter Violet’s realm.
Your task is to help her find them all so they can return home. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45486242/815e2db18f3462b8140f58cb4cf888aa05243b9a.gif[/img]

At the moment, the demo includes two levels, but the full game will have six levels, with the number of creatures increasing in each one. The game will be available in several languages and will be compatible with Windows and Mac.

[h3]About Development[/h3]
It took me eight months of working in my free time to create the demo, and I am excited to see people playing it!
I have always loved drawing since I was little; but I never considered making a game with my drawings.
One day, I thought it would be nice to try my hand at game design, and that’s how I came up with the idea of making a simple and cozy hidden object game.
The initial idea was to find different objects, but after some trials, I realized it would be more fun to look for animals or creatures rather than objects. When I looked back at my drawings, I noticed that I often ended up with weird and cute creatures in them. So I started again from scratch and decided that this game would be about finding cute, silly creatures.
After I drew the creatures, my boyfriend and I jokingly recorded silly sounds for them when discovered, but we ended up really liking the idea—so we recorded voices for all of them.

Thank you so much for reading and taking an interest in the game! I invite you to join my [url=https://discord.gg/GyQkccrsq8]Discord[/url], where you can share your thoughts on the game and follow its progress ❤️😊
